emulators.name: Vita3K

inAppSetup.title: Install Firmware
inAppSetup.instruction: On Vita3K's first-run Install Firmware page (or Install Firmware in its app list), install Main Firmware and Font Package from your own console. Pre-Install Package is optional.

inAppSetup.title: Add your games
inAppSetup.instruction: In Vita3K, Install App, then pick the .zip or .vpk you dumped from your own console. Vita3K keeps games in its own storage, not in ROMs.

emulators.romFolderNote: Install games in Vita3K first. For ES-DE, add a Game Name.psvita file in ROMs/psvita for each one, containing its title ID (like PCSE00000).

firstRunSteps: Open Cocoon and go through its first screens
For Data folder, tap Create new folder, name it Cocoon-Media, and use it
At ROM folder, tap Select directory, pick ROMs and allow access
When it says platforms found, open it and keep them all
